title: Tool Invocation (v1)
description: Request envelope for invoking a registered tool through the tool-gateway. The caller provides the tool name, tool-specific parameters, and the identity context forwarded from gateway authentication.

tool_name.description: Registered tool identifier following the naming convention <system>.<verb>_<noun>, e.g. k8s.list_pods.

parameters.description: Tool-specific parameters. Shape is defined by the tool's parameters_schema.

identity_context.description: Identity attributes forwarded from gateway authentication (sub, roles, username).

request_id.description: Unique identifier for this invocation request, used for correlation and audit.
